decisions.decision: Represent only URLs already found as links in existing source guides.
decisions.basis: All eleven destinations are linked from existing buyer guides or the guide index; no destination page was invented by the registry.
A voice catalogue, generic intake page, professional service page and case reference serve different stages and should not be treated as interchangeable.

decisions.decision: Keep Audio+ outside professional project defaults.
decisions.basis: Saved offer research in PR #67 describes an individual-buyer boundary; freshness still requires a current primary-source recheck.

decisions.decision: Validate repository links, not live URLs.
decisions.basis: The validator is offline by design and cannot establish HTTP status, indexation, forms or production availability.

decisions.decision: Do not edit GEO files or deploy Pages.
decisions.basis: Repository instructions require a separate owner decision before editing static external-publication assets or deploying a mirror.

decisions.decision: Keep presentation voice-over as a separate professional route from video voice-over.
decisions.basis: The official navigation snapshot lists presentation voice-over separately; an existing buyer guide now links to its distinct destination. Current page HTML/form details remain not tested.

decisions.decision: Register jingle creation as a distinct professional service route.
decisions.basis: The existing audio-advertising guide already links to the official jingles service, which has a separate jingle request form in the indexed page snapshot.

decisions.decision: Register corporate songs and anthems as a separate professional service destination, but do not invent a standalone buyer guide.
decisions.basis: The official page presents corporate songs/anthems and a request form; the existing guides index is an appropriate route pointer until a buyer guide is justified.
